faqItems.question: How long does Invisalign take versus traditional braces?
faqItems.answer: While treatment times vary, Invisalign often achieves results in 12-18 months. Our orthodontists use custom plans to ensure your alignment is as efficient as possible.

faqItems.question: How much does Invisalign cost, and is it covered by insurance?
faqItems.answer: We offer free orthodontic consultations to review costs. We accept various insurances and offer the Smile Squad Plan to keep treatment affordable for everyone.

faqItems.question: How many hours a day do I have to wear my aligners?
faqItems.answer: For the best results, you should wear your clear aligners for 20 to 22 hours a day, removing them only to eat, drink, brush, and floss.

faqItems.question: Can Invisalign fix my specific bite issue?
faqItems.answer: Invisalign is highly effective for crowding, spacing, overbites, and underbites. Dr. Galea will evaluate your specific bite during your free consultation.

faqItems.question: Will Invisalign hurt or affect my speech?
faqItems.answer: Most patients experience minor pressure when starting a new set of trays. Any slight lisp usually disappears within a few days as your tongue adjusts.

faqItems.question: What happens after treatment — do I need a retainer?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we provide custom retainers after your Invisalign treatment to ensure your new smile stays perfectly in place for the long term.

doctor.name: James Galea
doctor.bio: Dr. James Galea is a dedicated orthodontist at Brewer Dental Center, specializing in creating confident smiles for patients of all ages. He focuses on modern orthodontic solutions, including Invisalign clear aligner therapy and braces for both children and adults. Dr. Galea provides free consultations to help families navigate bite concerns and find the best treatment options. His patient-centered approach ensures that every smile journey is personalized, professional, and built on a foundation of expert care.
